## What's in this release

- Mochi lives in your notch — breathing, blinking, eyes that follow your cursor
- Claude Code sessions: live steps, approve permissions, answer questions, jump to terminal
- Built-in Claude chat from the notch
- Drop a file on the notch → ask a question or send it by email
- Drag Mochi onto any window to attach it as context
- Integrations: Stripe, n8n, GitHub, Vercel, Resend, Notion, Cal.com
- 28 handcrafted sounds
- Hides when idle, peeks when you hover

## First launch

macOS will say it can't verify Coucou (free side project, not notarized).

Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**, or run in Terminal:

```
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Coucou.app
```

## Build from source

```bash
brew install xcodegen
git clone https://github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou.git
cd coucou/NotchBuddy && xcodegen && open NotchBuddy.xcodeproj
```

releases.notes:
Ledge is a Markdown notebook that runs the code in your notes.

## New in 0.1.4

- **Ledge for Android** is in an open beta on Google Play, and anyone can join: [ledge.sh/android](https://ledge.sh/android) has the three steps. It pairs with a server the same way the iPhone app does.
- The manual inside the app and on every server now covers Android: pairing, where the app keeps its key and passwords, sharing, and the keyboard.

## Install

**Mac**, for Apple Silicon: the DMG below. Drag Ledge to Applications and open it from there.

**Linux**: `linux-x64-Ledge-Setup.tar.gz` or `linux-arm64-Ledge-Setup.tar.gz` below. Extract it and run `./installer`. It needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1 (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 38 or newer).

**Windows**: `win-x64-Ledge-Setup.zip` below. Right-click it, choose Extract All, and run `Ledge-Setup.exe` from the extracted folder. It needs WSL: if Ledge says it is missing, run `wsl --install` in an administrator PowerShell and restart. Windows may say it protected your PC while the installer is new: choose More info, then Run anyway.

**iPhone and iPad**: [Ledge Notebook](https://apps.apple.com/app/ledge-notebook/id6813315782) on the App Store.

**Android**: the Google Play beta, through [ledge.sh/android](https://ledge.sh/android).

Every desktop app updates itself.

A server, signed in as the account Ledge should use:

```
curl -fsSL https://ledge.sh/server.sh | sh
```

Then `~/.ledge/.server/bin/ledge pair` prints a code to scan with Ledge on a phone, or to paste into the desktop app's Add Server form.

The manual is at [ledge.sh/docs](https://ledge.sh/docs), and inside the app behind the help button.

Ledge is a Markdown notebook that runs the code in your notes.

## New in 0.1.3

- **Ledge for Linux**, on x64 and arm64. The same notebook, with Ctrl in place of ⌘, installed under your home folder with no root.
- **Ledge for Windows**, on Windows 11 x64. Your notes live in WSL and every block runs there, as a Linux command. The app installs its own server into WSL and keeps it at the app's version. The installer is signed.

## Fixed in 0.1.3

- The note browser's error strip can be dismissed, and a notice replaces an error that is still showing (#6).
- A window whose connection drops while it is still opening now reconnects, instead of staying on "Connecting… No answer yet." (#7).
- A block that finishes while the connection is down shows how long it really ran once the window reconnects.

releases.notes:
## Editing diagrams, equations and metadata

- Clicking a diagram no longer hides it or shifts the page. The diagram stays in place and its source opens in a card attached directly below it.
- The preview follows your edits after a short pause and keeps the previous diagram on screen while the new one lays out, so it never flashes blank.
- Diagram, equation and front matter sources are syntax highlighted (Mermaid, LaTeX, YAML) in light and dark themes.

## Tables

- One tidy toolbar: layout, alignment, row and column moves, and delete. Moves that are not possible from the current cell are disabled.
- Clicking into or out of a table no longer shifts its columns or text.

## Fixed

- The update download could show 0% for the whole download. Progress now falls back to the release's file size, and otherwise shows the amount downloaded.
- Paragraphs with inline math no longer shift horizontally when clicked.
- Code in custom dark themes now uses the dark syntax colours.

## Under the hood

- Tauri 2.12 with updated plugins, Vite 8, KaTeX 0.18, js-yaml 5, TypeScript 6 and ESLint 10, plus updated Rust crates (file watching, encoding detection).

## Faster

- Editing no longer re-renders the whole document. Typing, moving table rows and columns, and moving blocks now take a single frame even in long documents (previously about half a second on a 160-block document).
- Switching tabs reuses each block's rendered output and cached diagrams: about 25 ms instead of about 580 ms on the same document.
- Faster startup: syntax grammars load per language when first needed, and KaTeX and the emoji catalog load right after the window appears. The startup bundle is half its previous size.
- Theme switches re-render only diagrams, and leaving Source mode reuses unchanged blocks.
- Autosave skips rewriting a recovery copy that has not changed.

## Fixed

- Typed spaces could be saved as non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) in paragraphs, lists and headings, and a space typed after `##` could disappear.
- Typing `#` then a space in a new block put the space before the `#`.
- Mermaid diagrams could go blank after an edit elsewhere in the document.
- Nested numbered lists (for example `3.` under a bullet) jumped when clicked into.
- Bullets in loose lists sat on their own line above the item text in the preview.
- Arrow Up and Arrow Down did not leave a heading, list or quote from its first or last line.
- Escape did not close a dialog after clicking into the document behind it.
- The selection toolbar could overlap the document toolbar near the top of the page.

## Validation

All unit and browser tests pass, including a new rendering performance benchmark (`pnpm test:perf`) with a Kafka-themed stress document. Rendered output is unchanged from v1.1.0.

## What's new

- Open multiple documents in tabs, drag tabs to reorder them, and scroll overflowing tabs alongside the command search and editor mode controls.
- Refreshed sidebar navigation, file tree, icons, and table insertion dialog.
- Improved keyboard navigation, modal focus handling, accessible labels, and focus indicators.
- More consistent Markdown rendering while editing lists, nested formatting, callouts, and embedded code.
- Equations, diagrams, metadata, footnotes, tables of contents, and supported HTML blocks keep their preview while source is edited in a floating panel.
- Expanded emoji coverage with Unicode 17 data and shortcode completion.
- Improved physics notation, equation numbering and references, and legacy sequence/flow diagram compatibility.
- Reorder table rows and columns with drag handles or keyboard controls. Structural edits refuse malformed tables that could lose extra cells.
- Structured YAML metadata, optional sandboxed HTTPS embeds, and explicitly configured image uploads.

## Validation and compatibility

12,538 automated checks pass. All 90 Markdown fixtures pass whole-document preview, editor-block preview, and exact source-preservation checks. TypeScript, ESLint, the production build, and the offline Rust check pass.

Native visual behavior, screen-reader output, and real image upload services were not verified in this pass. Math uses KaTeX with a compatibility layer; legacy diagrams use Mermaid layout. This release does not claim complete MathJax or pixel-identical Typora compatibility.

See docs/MARKDOWN-FIXES.md for implementation details and engine limitations.

## Highlights

### 运行时能力增强

- 新增 AI Core 异常 dump：硬件异常时保存 kernel 输入并支持恢复为 NumPy；默认关闭，要求 CANN 9.3.0 或更高版本（[#1462](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1462)）。
- 改善安装和设备探测：支持不依赖 `TL_ROOT` / `set_env.sh` 的 `pip install -e .`（[#1053](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1053)），并改用 ACL 获取 NPU 设备名以避免 `torch_npu` fork 问题（[#1694](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1694)）。

### 编译器、Pass 与 DSL API

- 新增 Ascend workspace reduction Pass，Developer 模式可自动完成 UB↔L1、L0C↔UB 经 GM workspace 的两段搬运（[#1002](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1002)）；Tile API 进一步支持逐调用显式 `tmp=` workspace arena，便于 Expert 模式手动内存规划（[#1496](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1496)）。
- 扩展数据搬运和 Tile API：`T.copy` 动态 shape（[#969](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/969)）、L0C→GM atomic add（[#980](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/980)）、PTO sort/topk 与 gather（[#973](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/973)、[#1008](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1008)）、PTO `atomic_add` codegen（[#1083](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1083)）、`row_expand_mul` 及 row-expand/brcb 实验 API（[#1168](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1168)、[#1255](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1255)）、运行时动态 slice 长度的 `T.tile.fill`（[#1295](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1295)）。
- 建立可选的尾块 valid-region 处理框架，覆盖元素级运算、受限的 axis-0 reduction，以及 compare/select/broadcast；不满足契约的场景保留原后端路径（[#1360](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1360)、[#1421](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1421)、[#1541](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1541)）。
- 新增 `AscendSyncInsertVS`，补齐 V→V 与 S↔其他流水线的同步插入，并持续修复冗余同步和 packed-mask 生命周期同步（[#1346](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1346)、[#1384](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1384)、[#1706](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1706)、[#1713](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1713)）。
- Bisheng 编译参数改为 kernel-scoped；新增 `compile_flags` 参数并纳入 cache key，避免进程级环境变量污染后续 kernel（[#1389](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1389)）。
- 扩展 GEMM/矩阵路径：`gemm_v0/mma` 支持运行时 `n_actual`（[#1352](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1352)）、`kL0Size`（[#1387](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1387)），kernel 可显式驱动 L1→L0→MMA→Fixpipe 序列（[#1422](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1422)）；同时优化非 16×16 对齐 transpose（[#1408](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1408)）。
- 加强内存规划与 codegen 健壮性：循环感知 liveness（[#1234](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1234)）、临时 UB 地址防重叠（[#1300](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1300)）、动态 extent 与符号 shape 修复（[#1311](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1311)、[#1337](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1337)），以及 `if_then_else` 生成与求值顺序修复（[#1364](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1364)、[#1391](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1391)、[#1749](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1749)）。

### 新增与强化的算子/示例

- Attention/MLA：Seer Attention 与 block-sparse attention（[#983](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/983)）、HISA Paged Block Sparse MQA（[#1254](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1254)、[#1361](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1361)）、XAttention/Paged Beam Search（[#1255](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1255)、[#1284](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1284)）、MTGR ragged segment attention（[#1403](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1403)）、DeepSeek Sparse Flash MLA（[#1457](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1457)）。

### 稳定性与正确性

- 内存规划和 codegen 修复覆盖循环 liveness、临时 UB 地址重叠、`LetStmt` 崩溃、symbolic shape、disk cache 重载，以及 `if_then_else` 生成顺序/括号问题（[#1234](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1234)、[#1300](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1300)、[#1334](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1334)、[#1311](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1311)、[#1622](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1622)、[#1364](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1364)、[#1391](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1391)、[#1749](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1749)）。

## 兼容性与升级注意事项

- **Breaking：`T.alloc_local` 已删除**（[#1229](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1229)）。标量或线程私有存储改用 `T.alloc_var`；tile buffer 改用 `T.alloc_shared` / `T.alloc_fragment`，或 Ascend 专用的 `T.alloc_ub`、`T.alloc_L1`、`T.alloc_L0A/L0B/L0C`。
- **Breaking：旧字符串式 `T.init_flag` / `T.clear_flag` 已删除**（[#1495](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1495)）。请改用结构化的 `T.set_flag` / `T.wait_flag`；同一 PR 还收紧了 row-expand 的连续性、对齐、dtype、行数和 workspace 校验，过去被静默接受的非法调用现在会报错。
- **Ascend 内存 scope 名称统一**（[#1332](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1332)）：`shared.dyn` 改为 `shared.l1`，`shared` 改为 `shared.ub`。直接依赖底层 scope 字符串的自定义代码、Pass 或测试需要同步更新。
- **示例路径调整**：`examples/deepseek_v4/sparse_flash_attention.py` 改名为 `sparse_attention.py`（[#999](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/999)）；11 个实验算子目录迁至 `examples_experiment/`（[#1424](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1424)）；`group_norm` 和 `cummin` 迁至 `examples/cann-bench/`（[#1542](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1542)）。
- **Skill 名称调整**（[#1466](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1466)）：`tilelang-op-generate` → `tilelang-op-develop`，`tilelang-expert-to-developer` → `tilelang-programming-model-guide`，`tilelang-review-skill` → `tilelang-review`。引用旧名称的脚本或编排配置需要更新。
- **自动同步配置清理**（[#1716](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1716)）：`enable_auto_sync` PrimFunc attribute 是无效旧配置，现已移除残留用法；应使用 `PassConfigKey.TL_ASCEND_AUTO_SYNC`。
- **Bisheng flags 优先级**（[#1389](https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang-ascend/pull/1389)）：环境变量仍是只读 fallback，kernel 的 `compile_flags` 参数优先并进入 cache key。

# TileLang AscendNPU-IR Release Notes — 2026.4.30

**Version:** 0.1.1.030
**Tag:** `v0.1.1.030-pre-release`

---

## 🧠 AI Agent Skills System

This release introduces a comprehensive **AI Agent Skills System** (`.agents/skills/`) with 9 specialized skills for NPU-IR development, enabling AI-assisted kernel authoring, debugging, and workflow automation:

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tilelang-npuir-overview` | NPU-IR architecture and compile pipeline overview |
| `tilelang-vector-skill` | Vector operator generation (v-prefix APIs: `vadd`, `vmul`, `vexp`, `vcast`, etc.) |
| `tilelang-cube-skill` | Cube GEMM operator development with `load_nd2nz` / `store_fixpipe` |
| `tilelang-mixcv-skill` | Mixed Cube+Vector kernels (e.g., Flash Attention pipelines) |
| `tilelang-mlir-skill` | TileLangIR / MLIR pass workflow and transform debugging |
| `tilelang-debug-helper` | GDB + IR dump + pass-level debug workflow |
| `tilelang-error-fixer` | Compile/runtime/pass failure diagnosis and repair |
| `tilelang-review-skill` | Risk-first code review and CI-aligned format checks |
| `tilelang-github-operations` | Commit, rebase, PR, and issue workflow automation |

Each skill includes reference documentation and is automatically triggered by matching user queries, providing context-aware guidance for NPU-IR kernel development.

---

Official DeepSeek V4 operator examples are now available, covering the core sparse attention compute patterns:

### DeepSeek V4 (`examples/deepseek_v4/`)

| `example_sparse_attn_kernel_highperf.py` | High-performance sparse attention variant |

| `example_act_quant_kernel.py` | Activation quantization kernel |
| `example_hc_split_sinkhorn_kernel.py` | Hierarchical clustering Sinkhorn kernel |
| `example_mhc_post.py` | Multi-head clustering post-processing |

## 🔧 CI Pipeline Completion

The CI/CD infrastructure has been significantly hardened:

- **9 GitHub Actions workflows** covering build, test, publish, and dependency management
- **APT cache** added for Ascend CI to accelerate build times (#767)
- **Examples integrated into CI** — all operator examples are now automatically tested (#767)
- **Docker support** for containerized build and test environments (#756)

---

## 📚 Documentation Expansion

The documentation has been greatly enriched:

- **80+ API reference pages** under `docs/Tilelang.language/` organized into 14 categories:
  - 数学操作 (Math ops: `vadd`, `vmul`, `vexp`, `vsin`, `vtanh`, etc.)
  - 内存操作 (Memory ops: `load_nd2nz`, `store_fixpipe`, `alloc_L1`, `copy`, etc.)
  - 规约操作 (Reduction ops: `reduce_sum`, `reduce_max`)
  - 同步管道操作 (Pipeline sync: `sync_block_set`, `sync_block_wait`, `pipe_barrier`)

  - 数据类型转换 (Type casting: `vcast`, `vbitcast`)
  - 逻辑/比较/条件/索引/shape/排序/原子/调试操作 and more

releases.notes:
Parrot now nudges you while a call drifts, shows how the call went at the top of every report, and adds a second free on-device model that's faster than Whisper for European languages.

**Live nudges.** A short tip appears over whatever app the call is in, for about ten seconds: *"They've gone quiet since you said 'the price goes up in January'."* It catches long silences after you speak, a monologue, talking over them, answers that have gone short, speeding up, and saying the same thing again. With the Copilot on, it also flags a mood shift, a question you didn't answer, and a call wrapping up with no next step. The same tip sits above the coach line in the Copilot panel. At most one every two minutes, none in the first two, and the tip is kept out of screen sharing. It reads timing and words, never emotion from anyone's voice. On by default; turn it off in **Settings > Copilot > Live Nudges**.

**How the call went.** The Report tab now opens with a timeline: your talk share against theirs, minute by minute, the profile's main gauge over the call, and numbered moments (tips, turning points and the moments you marked) with Play. It uses what the call already produced, so it costs no extra AI.

**Parakeet v3, a second free on-device model.** Pick it in **Settings > Transcription**. It's the fastest option and just as private, but it only knows 25 European languages, so no Turkish. On auto-detect, Parrot listens to each side for a few seconds first: a language Parakeet knows goes to Parakeet, anything else goes to Whisper, which only loads when it's needed. If the call changes language later, that side switches and the last stretch is redone. New installs get Parakeet when every language they use is one of its 25.

**Call language, right under Start recording.** Pick Auto-detect or the call's language on the dashboard before you start. If the call doesn't sound like the language you picked, a banner across the call screen now says so with **Switch** and **Keep** buttons, instead of a small label that was easy to miss. Parrot also keeps listening every 30 seconds, so a call that changes language halfway is caught too.

**Your calendar, your events.** Only your own events name a recording now: ones you organise, accepted or said maybe to. Under **Settings > Recording > Calendar**, you can also untick calendars Parrot shouldn't read, like a shared team calendar or events found in Mail.

**Fixed**
- The other side's audio could start several seconds late when nothing was playing as you hit record, so their first lines arrived in a burst.
- A recording could be named after someone else's event, such as an invite you hadn't answered on a shared calendar.
- A language picked in Settings was only checked at the start of the call, so switching language mid-call went unnoticed.
- Talk share in the report and the coaching counted words, which under-counted languages like Turkish. It now counts seconds of speech, like the live gauge.

No new permissions. Parakeet downloads about 0.5 GB the first time you pick it, plus Whisper Tiny (40 MB) for the language check and a 626 MB Whisper model in the background for languages Parakeet doesn't know.

Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. Existing installs will offer the update within a day.

Parrot now catches a call that isn't in the language you picked, before it costs you the transcript.

**A heads-up in the first few seconds.** A language you set in Settings is followed exactly, so a Turkish call with English picked used to come out as English-sounding nonsense, and Copilot had nothing useful to read. Now Parrot listens to the first few seconds of speech on each call. If it hears something else, the device bar at the top of the call screen shows **sounds like Turkish, switch to Turkish** (with whatever language it heard). One click fixes the rest of the call and your next ones.

**Deepgram and auto-detect.** Deepgram's auto-detect only knows ten languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Russian, Portuguese, Japanese, Italian and Dutch. Settings now warns you when Deepgram is on auto-detect, and the live check covers it too, so Turkish, Arabic, Chinese and Korean calls get the right language.

**Fixed**
- A call in a language other than the one picked in Settings produced a nonsense transcript, empty Copilot and no report, with no warning.

No new permissions or downloads.

Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. Existing installs will offer the update within a day.

The welcome tour now shows how to use your meetings in Claude, Cursor and Codex, and says plainly what that sends.

**A new step before Ready.** New installs see Claude, Cursor and Codex with a couple of example questions. **Connect Claude** turns on the connection and opens Claude's install screen, and **Continue** skips it. Cursor, Codex and Claude Code connect from **Claude & AI Apps** in the sidebar any time.

**Honest about privacy.** The step says it straight: this is the one part of Parrot that isn't private like the rest. When you ask, what the app reads goes to its company under your account. It stays off until you connect, and never sees audio, API keys or on-device-only meetings. If you choose **Private** in the tour, the step is left out.

Want the tour again? **Help > Show Welcome Tour**.

No new permissions or downloads.

Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. Existing installs will offer the update within a day.

Your meetings can now answer questions inside Claude, Cursor and Codex, and every recording keeps both sides of the call in step.

**Use your meetings in Claude.** Open **Claude & AI Apps** in the sidebar and connect Claude Desktop in one click, or copy a ready-made command for Claude Code, Codex (in ChatGPT) or Cursor. Then ask in the app you already use: "What did I promise last week?", "Brief me for my call with Acme", "Draft the follow-up for this morning's call". Your own plan does the thinking. It's free, there's no meeting bot, and your meetings stay on your Mac until an app asks.

**What the AI gets.** Search by meaning, narrowed by date or person. Long transcripts in pages, with real speaker names. Promises with who owns them, talk time, and four ready-made actions in Claude's **+** menu: weekly digest, follow-up email, prep for a call and PRD from calls. When it quotes a moment, the time is a link that opens Parrot on that line.

**You choose what it sees.** The connection is read-only. Pick what's shared (transcripts, reports, notes, Copilot cards, whole call types). On-device-only meetings, audio and keys are never shown, and the page tells you how often an app read your meetings today.

**Fixed**

- Playback put the other side of the call out of step with you. Their audio started a few seconds late on every recording, and up to 20 seconds late when Parrot had to switch to its backup way of hearing the call, so answers could play before their questions and voices overlapped. Both sides now run on one clock, and the transcript order follows it. Recordings made before this update keep their old timing.
- A voice's **Play** clip under "listen and name them" also played your side, so it sounded loud and like two people at once. It now plays only that voice.

The AI app connection is off until you turn it on. No new permissions or downloads.

Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. Existing installs will offer the update within a day.
